now.title: Black Panther
now.text: Ayo guards the royal family at T'Challa's coronation and points her spear at M'Baku when he steps menacingly toward Shuri, before he challenges T'Challa for the throne.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Jabari leader Ayo holds at spear point at the coronation.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Dora Milaje who points her spear at M'Baku at the coronation.

proposed.text: Ayo guards the royal family at T'Challa's coronation and points her spear at M'Baku when he steps menacingly toward Shuri, before he challenges T'Challa for the throne. In the final battle, M'Baku's Jabari arrive to save Ayo, Shuri, Nakia and Okoye from the Border Tribe, and they fight on the same side.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Jabari leader Ayo holds at spear point, whose warriors later save her in battle.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Dora Milaje who points her spear at M'Baku, then fights on his side against Killmonger.

changes.evidence: Black Panther: in the final battle Ayo, Shuri, Nakia and Okoye are cornered by the Border Tribe until the Jabari Tribe joins the battle, enabling Ayo to resume the fight; the film leaves them on the same side, not rivals.

now.title: Jessica Jones S2#11
now.text: Karl Malus is the IGH doctor who saved Jessica's life and gave her powers through experiments. She hunts him for answers and wants him dead for what he did to her mother.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The IGH doctor who saved Jessica's life and gave her powers.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Malus saved and gave powers, who wants him dead.

proposed.text: Karl Malus is the IGH doctor who saved Jessica's life and gave her powers through experiments. After she hunts him down, Trish forces him to experiment on her, and when Jessica stops it, Malus sets his lab on fire with himself inside.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Malus saved and gave powers, who stops his experiment on Trish.

changes.evidence: Jessica Jones S2#10: Jessica helps Malus plan an escape to Uruguay rather than wanting him dead. S2#11 'AKA Three Lives and Counting': Trish kidnaps Malus to give her powers; Jessica stops the procedure, nearly kills him but stops herself, and Malus destroys the facility with himself inside. The current text omits this and gives a motive ('wants him dead for what he did to her mother') the sources do not support.

now.title: Agent Carter S1#7
now.text: Roger Dooley is Peggy Carter's chief at the SSR and mostly keeps her on desk duty. When the evidence points to her helping Howard Stark, he has her interrogated and fires her, but he comes to believe her warning about Ivchenko just before Fennhoff takes over his mind.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peggy's SSR chief, who fires her, then comes to believe her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Dooley's agent, kept on desk duty, whom he fires and then believes.

proposed.text: Roger Dooley is Peggy Carter's chief at the SSR and mostly keeps her on desk duty. When the evidence points to her helping Howard Stark, he has her hunted down and interrogated, but he comes to believe her warning about Ivchenko just before Fennhoff takes over his mind.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peggy's SSR chief, who has her arrested, then comes to believe her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Dooley's agent, kept on desk duty, whom he has arrested and then believes.

changes.evidence: Agent Carter S1#6 'A Sin to Err': Dooley declares Peggy a fugitive and she is arrested; S1#7 'SNAFU': Dooley, Thompson and Sousa interrogate her, then Dooley accepts she is telling the truth before Ivchenko hypnotizes him. No source has him firing her.

now.text: Betty Brant is Jameson's secretary and stays calm through his outbursts.
